title: 5-Axis Pipeline Completion
brief: 10 sub-milestones: collision at every AB angle (10u), dialect (5u), trunnion/swivel/gantry DB (7u), barrel/lollipop tooling (8u), fixture (6u), pipeline (8u), optimization (5u), TRAORI/M128/DWO controllers (7u), singularity/scallop physics (10u), testing 10 parts × 4 machines (12u).
